def test_wallet_topup_and_balance():
    _, _, token = create_user_and_get_token()
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    balance_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance")
    resp = requests.get(balance_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    wallet_info = resp.json()
    assert wallet_info.get("balance") == 0
    address = wallet_info.get("address")
    assert address, "Wallet address should be present"

    topup_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup")
    resp = requests.get(topup_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    topup_info = resp.json()
    new_balance = topup_info.get("balance")
    assert new_balance > 0
    assert topup_info.get("address") == address

    resp = requests.get(balance_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("balance") == new_balance

    resp = requests.get(topup_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_wallet_transfer_exact_balance():
    _, _, token_a = create_user_and_get_token()
    _, _, token_b = create_user_and_get_token()

    headers_a = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_a}"}
    headers_b = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_b}"}

    topup_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup")
    resp = requests.get(topup_url, headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_a_initial = resp.json().get("balance")

    balance_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance")
    resp = requests.get(balance_url, headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_b = resp.json().get("address")
    balance_b_initial = resp.json().get("balance")

    transfer_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer")
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": balance_a_initial}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(balance_url, headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("balance") == 0

    resp = requests.get(balance_url, headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("balance") == balance_b_initial + balance_a_initial

def test_auth_signup_login_and_user_me():
    user = generate_random_string()
    password = generate_random_string()

    signup_url = get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup")
    resp = requests.post(signup_url, json={"user": user, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    token = resp.json().get("token")
    assert token, "Token should be present in signup response"

    me_url = get_url("gateway", "/user/me")
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    me_resp = requests.get(me_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert me_resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {me_resp.status_code}: {me_resp.text}"
    assert me_resp.json().get("user") == user

    login_url = get_url("gateway", "/auth/login")
    resp = requests.post(login_url, json={"user": user, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    login_token = resp.json().get("token")
    assert login_token, "Token should be present in login response"

    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {login_token}"}
    resp = requests.get(me_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    user_info = resp.json()
    assert user_info.get("user") == user
    assert "name" in user_info
    assert "enabled" in user_info

def test_wallet_transfer_success():
    _, _, token_a = create_user_and_get_token()
    _, _, token_b = create_user_and_get_token()

    headers_a = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_a}"}
    headers_b = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_b}"}

    topup_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup")
    resp = requests.get(topup_url, headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_a_initial = resp.json().get("balance")

    balance_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance")
    resp = requests.get(balance_url, headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_b = resp.json().get("address")
    balance_b_initial = resp.json().get("balance")

    transfer_amount = 10
    transfer_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer")
    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": transfer_amount}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    transfer_info = resp.json()
    assert transfer_info.get("balance") == balance_a_initial - transfer_amount

    resp = requests.get(balance_url, headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("balance") == balance_a_initial - transfer_amount

    resp = requests.get(balance_url, headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("balance") == balance_b_initial + transfer_amount

def test_wallet_transfer_negative_cases():
    _, _, token_a = create_user_and_get_token()
    _, _, token_b = create_user_and_get_token()

    headers_a = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_a}"}
    headers_b = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_b}"}

    topup_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup")
    resp = requests.get(topup_url, headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_a = resp.json().get("balance")

    balance_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance")
    resp = requests.get(balance_url, headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_b = resp.json().get("address")

    transfer_url = get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer")

    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": -5}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": balance_a + 100}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"to": "invalid_address_123", "amount": 10}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"amount": 10}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.post(transfer_url, headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
